question: Connection of voltage transformer and current transformer across line are _______, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __series and parallel__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Voltage transformers__ are connected across the line in parallel configuration.
 
• __Current transformers__ are connected in series with the line.
 
• The parallel connection of voltage transformers ensures accurate voltage measurement across the line without affecting the circuit.
 
• Series connection of current transformers allows for the measurement of the current flowing through the line.
 
• Both transformers are used for protection and metering purposes in electrical systems.
 
• Proper connection ensures the reliability and safety of the electrical network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Voltage Transformer:**

 
 
• It is used to step down the voltage for measurement or protection purposes.
 
• Operates accurately when connected in parallel to the circuit.
 
 
 
• **Current Transformer:**
 
 
• It is used to step down high current to a lower level for measurement.
 
• Operates accurately when connected in series with the circuit.
